title: Tailwise Plus Member Relief on Tailwise Grooming Salon Prepaid Pass Late-Cancellation Fees
content:
**Member benefit statement.** Members of Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus whose paid Tailwise Plus membership is in status active receive a relief on the pass late-cancellation fee charged on a prepaid Tailwise Grooming Salon pass (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom or Spa Groom pass).

The Tailwise Plus relief on the pass late-cancellation fee follows the customer's rewards membership in status active:

| Customer's rewards membership in status active | Tailwise Plus relief |
|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 50 percent |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | 25 percent |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | 25 percent |
| a free Pals Rewards tier (Pals Rewards Member, Pals Rewards Insider, Pals Rewards VIP) | none |
| no active membership | none |

**How the relief is applied.** The relief reduces the pass late-cancellation fee once, by its percentage. Where the fee carries more than one percentage relief, the reliefs are first added into one relief percentage, never above 100 percent, and the fee is reduced once by that combined percentage; the reliefs do not act one after the other.

**Where the tier is read.** The membership and its status are those on the customer's Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus membership record; a membership in any status other than active gives no relief.

**Illustrations (hypothetical fee of 30.00 before relief)**

| Membership in status active | Relief | Fee after relief |
|---|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 50 percent | 15.00 |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | 25 percent | 22.50 |
| Pals Rewards VIP | none | 30.00 |

Combined with another percentage relief of 50 percent on the same fee, a Tailwise Plus Annual member's 25 percent gives a combined 75 percent: 30.00 reduced by 75 percent is 7.50. Combined with another relief of 100 percent, a Tailwise Plus Premier Annual member's 50 percent is held at the 100 percent ceiling and the fee is reduced to 0.00.
